claims.correction_note: Protein-associated EGP framed as possible rather than a quantified unopposed 2–5 h T1D flux.
claims.bg_short_quote: The result is unopposed hepatic glucose output ... over 2–5 h
claims.source: Dao et al. 2025 review original PDF
claims.region: Protein Ingestion and EGP; Kinetics of the Glucose Response to Protein
claims.quantitative_context: Review's approximately 20–25% whey-associated EGP increments concern people without diabetes; direct T1D protein-induced EGP measurements are sparse.

Healthy-participant quantitative examples cannot be promoted to T1D

claims.correction_note: Stale full-text caveat removed; Søeborg association model scoped to formulation and experiment.
claims.region: Section 2.1 and Table 1 with insulin species, temperatures, methods and equilibrium constants
claims.quantitative_context: The paper cites zinc-free soluble human-insulin hexamer fractions 50%, 75%, 100% at 33, 167, 250 U/mL; below about 5 U/mL smaller association states predominate. These are formulation- and experiment-dependent, not general analogue/T1D depot constants.
claims.proposal: Correct the acquisition-status sentence; include concentration examples only with zinc-free/model and method caveats.
limitations: Model synthesis of literature constants
Only one listed equilibrium study at 37 °C
Equation extraction not independently transcribed

claims.correction_note: Asp maximal-clamp values labelled mean ± SEM and PDF-acquisition caveat removed.
claims.bg_short_quote: Dispersion is reproduced from the accessible abstract without assuming it is a standard deviation
claims.region: Figure 3 legend and Discussion; numbered summary on PDF p. 1
claims.quantitative_context: Seven healthy participants; maximal clamp GIR 81.3 ± 3.2 versus 96.4 ± 8.8 µmol/kg/min, reported 15.7% decrease; figure legend explicitly says mean ± SEM. Local leg comparison P = .08.
claims.proposal: Label dispersion SEM and remove original-PDF acquisition priority; retain maximal/submaximal and local/systemic caveats.
limitations: Healthy small sample
Maximal clamp effect should not be generalized to submaximal insulin or T1D

claims.correction_note: Kirwan healthy-adult 48 h clamp contrast added without T1D dose extrapolation.
claims.bg_short_quote: human evidence comes mainly from small experiments in people without diabetes
claims.region: Abstract and beginning of Methods; eccentric/concentric/rest clamp protocol
claims.quantitative_context: Six healthy untrained adults; 48 h post-exercise insulin-mediated disposal 3.47 ± 0.51 eccentric versus 5.55 ± 0.94 concentric and 5.48 ± 1.0 mg/kg/min rest; mean ± SE; hepatic output not significantly different.
claims.proposal: Add comparator-specific healthy-adult 48 h evidence to section 10; do not imply cytokine mediation or a T1D dose factor.
limitations: Only first original page visually checked for the values
Small non-T1D sample
No direct cytokine mediator test

claims.correction_note: Tuominen post-marathon contrast added without cytokine attribution.
claims.bg_short_quote: glycogen depletion in the working fibers is a permissive condition
claims.region: Abstract and study context for next-morning marathon clamp
claims.quantitative_context: Nineteen male runners; muscle glycogen 37% lower, glycogen-synthase fractional activity 56% higher, yet clamp whole-body disposal 12% lower and glucose oxidation 36% lower the morning after a 42 km marathon.
claims.proposal: Use as a contrasting recovery protocol in section 10 and cross-reference section 8; avoid a fixed post-exercise resistance phase or cytokine explanation.
limitations: Only first original page visually checked for the values
Non-T1D male endurance athletes
Extreme 42 km exposure
